title: Finite evaluation of the open reduction mate
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, Operations o and a RealizationModel model [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge] and [def-sf-integral-system-operations], an open immersion j:X→Y, an arbitrary integral derived object K on X, and n≥0. Define openFiniteReduction(j,n) from scalar reduction of completed-ring extension by zero to finite constant-ring extension by zero of scalar reduction by the composite: finiteReductionIso(Y,n) inverse, PurCompactSupport.openComparison for reduction modulo exponent n+1, the localization of finiteOpenIso(j,n), and finite extension by zero of finiteReductionIso(X,n) [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison]. Evaluation at n of model.openReduction(j)_K, followed by reductionEvaluation(n) at the completed open extension of K, followed by openFiniteReduction(j,n)_K, equals the specified o.openEvaluation at the reduction of K followed by finite extension by zero of reductionEvaluation(n)_K. No proper image, total limit, inverse reconstruction unit or constructibility is asserted.

proof.text: Use integralReductionPullFiniteSquare to identify the evaluated whole-system pullback comparison with the scalar/pullback comparison. Use integralOpenScalarUnitSquare for the actual integral and finite open units. The private assemble lemma proves the resulting open mate equality: cancel the inverse open evaluation isomorphism, transpose under finiteOpenAdj, substitute both inverse-mate unit equations, use naturality of pullback evaluation and reductionEvaluation, and finally the scalar unit equation. The finite open-unit naturality equation closes the transpose. This uses no faithfulness of derived evaluation and no inverse limit.

theorem integralOpenFiniteEvaluation (o : Operations l E)
    (model : RealizationModel l E o) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (K : Integral l E X) (n : ℕ) :
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).map ((model.openReduction l E j).app K) ≫
      ((calculus l E Y).reductionEvaluation n).hom.app ((ringedOpen l E j).obj K) ≫
      (openFiniteReduction l E j n).app K =
    ((o.openEvaluation j).evaluation n).hom.app ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (((calculus l E X).reductionEvaluation n).hom.app K)
